initial_seed.basis: Attempt B provides the middle observed IR exposure with substantially more IR headroom than Attempt C. Attempt C improved reference agreement and correlation but reduced headroom and dominant-frequency consistency; therefore C is an upward adjustment target, not the default seed.

independent_hard_bounds.basis: All values are at or below the historically retained equal-current 0x5E/0x5E Z23 exposure. The new experiment physically retained 0x1F/0x1F, 0x1F/0x3E, and 0x1F/0x5E without clipping or adverse findings.

all_required: identity, session, configuration, rate, ordering, timestamps, and checksums valid
zero FIFO overflow and zero clipped samples
each channel mean DC is at least max(15000, 3 times its same-pair no-contact baseline)
each channel mean DC is at most 100000 counts
each channel raw maximum is below 209714 counts
relative DC shift between the two consecutive 50-pair blocks is at most 8 percent
the selected RED/IR pair is explicitly allowed

adjustment.weak_channel: increase only that channel by one adjacent level when the resulting pair is allowed
adjustment.excessive_dc_or_low_headroom: decrease only that channel by one adjacent level when the resulting pair is allowed
adjustment.both_channels_out_of_range: decide each channel independently, then require the resulting pair to be allowed
adjustment.unavailable_transition: ABSTAIN; do not force the other channel to move
adjustment.exposure_change_effect: discard the current evaluation and restart the 100-pair stability evaluation at the new pair

oscillation.definition: any revisit of a previously evaluated RED/IR pair or reversal of either channel before convergence

measurement_freeze.calibration_binding: device, sensor session, Z23, exact RED/IR pair, and policy ID/hash

limitations: Only the five listed pairs have retained Z23 evidence; other Cartesian combinations are forbidden.
LED currents are nominal register conversions, not electrical measurements.
Attempt order and time remain confounded.
Home-cuff pulse is a reference label, not beat-level or clinical ground truth.
Attempt A's cuff pulse value is absent from shared evidence and is not reconstructed.
The provisional DC and headroom guardrails require finite Stage 10 verification before runtime authorization.
